title: Frienhund Automatic Cat Feeder with 2K Camera: 5G WiFi Automatic Dog Feeder with Night Vision,Cat Food Dispenser with 7L Large Food Storage Container for Multiple Pet,Detachable for Easy Clean -29 Cup
say: Customers find the automatic feeder easy to set up and consider it good value for money, appreciating its camera feature and ability to schedule feedings. The connectivity receives mixed feedback, with some reporting no issues while others experience connection problems. The food capacity and portion size also get mixed reviews - while it holds plenty of food, customers note it can only hold a limited amount at a time, and while customers are content with the portion sizes, some wish for smaller options. The camera visibility is generally positive, with customers noting they can see their pets day or night, though some mention the camera doesn't show much.
